relevance_note: The paper is a case report plus a registry cohort review; the index case had ALDH5A1 variants: "ALDH5A1 sequencing revealed compound heterozygosity for 2 previously described mutations".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a short Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON and checked spans and fields. Rows: the case-report index patient (rule 5 'patient'; 'the index case' is a role word), his deceased sister (affected relative, not tested), his mother (tested carrier), and three adult deaths described in the Discussion with individual facts: the database patient who died at 33 ('unnamed person 1'), the posthumously diagnosed woman aged 19 whose neuropathology was published in ref 8 ('ref 8 patient'), and the man in his mid-20s known by oral communication ('unnamed person 2'). The father is mentioned only as untested ('Paternal DNA was not available') and is not affected, so he has no row. The registry cohort (112 in the database, 95 with age at diagnosis, 40 adults, 25 adults with adult data) is reported only as counts; the single table is a count table (n (%)) and was not used for any individual. '1 patient age 46' and '7 patients ages 30-39 (including 1 deceased)' from the age stratification were not given rows (stratification counts only); the deceased 30-39 patient may be the same person as 'unnamed person 1' (died at 33), but the paper does not say so, so no merge. cohort_size_as_stated = 112 (database total); the adult analysis cohort is 25. n_patients_reported left null: the paper does not state how many patients have an ALDH5A1 variant. Variant strings are recorded as printed: the conversion shows 'c.1015-2A.C' and 'c.608C.G' (the '.' likely stands for '>' in the original), not corrected. Inheritance of c.1015-2A.C is 'inherited maternal' (mother stated heterozygous for it); c.608C.G is 'not reported' (trans phase is only inferred; paternal DNA unavailable). Variant type 'splice' from '(mutation of canonical splice-site)'; no class is stated for c.608C.G. 'previously described mutations' was not taken as a pathogenicity classification. Index MRI: figure 1 legend ('a patient ... at age 62') is tied to the index patient by the text 'MRI (figure 1) demonstrated ...'. Parenchymal volume loss was mapped to the checklist item 'cerebral or cerebellar atrophy'. Normal basic laboratory screening (electrolytes, renal and hepatic function) recorded as three excluded abnormalities (D-27). 'interictal EEGs did not confirm nonconvulsive status epilepticus' recorded as excluded. Age at last evaluation for the index patient is the age at death (63). The SUDEP deaths are recorded as cause_of_death only, not as phenotypic features (hedged 'consistent with'). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients = true on the basis of the ref 8 patient only. No contradictions found. No stacked cells.
